prompts.proposer:
Call proposer_brief() FIRST. The tool output includes pattern_analyst_insights — use trend_champion, seasonality_champion, and insights.recommended_method_hint to bias your candidate selection toward non-mean methods. MUST propose at least 3 candidates including at least 1 non-baseline type. Return ONLY JSON per instructions. IMPORTANT: you MUST ONLY reference candidate names that appear in the tool output candidate_library; unknown names will hard-stop.
PATTERN ANALYST INSIGHTS: trend_champion='THETA', seasonality_champion='ARIMA', recommended_method='stl_hierarchical_stacking'. Narrative: THETA achieves perfect trend correlation (1.0) while ARIMA leads in seasonality (0.774), indicating complementary strengths across decomposition components. The extreme RMSE spread (26.5) and concept drift signal that STL-hierarchical stacking is optimal—it exploits the additive decomposition structure while mitigating model disagreement through component-wise combination. Early horizon specialist catboost (124.7 RMSE) differs from late specialist ONLY_FT_catboost (204.0 RMSE), further supporting horizon-aware or decomposition-based weighting.
